results.title: Minister Shri Jaykumar Rawal directs proposal for Maharashtra-Australia Biomanufacturing Task Force
results.description: The Department of Agricultural Marketing and Protocol, Government of Maharashtra, held discussions with a delegation of Australian biomanufacturing companies at Sahyadri Guest House in Mumbai under the chairmanship of Shri Jaykumar Rawal, Minister for Agricultural Marketing and Protocol. The meeting focused on opportunities for cooperation between Maharashtra and Australia in biotechnology, research, trade and investment. ...
